name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Your SimplePost API key. It starts with `sp_api_`. Create one in SimplePost under [API keys](https://app.simplepost.social/api-keys). API keys require a SimplePost plan with API access. For details, see the [SimplePost API documentation](https://docs.simplepost.social/api).

name: baseUrl
label: SimplePost URL
help: Leave as `https://app.simplepost.social` unless you run your own self-hosted SimplePost Scheduler. Enter the HTTPS address of that Scheduler without a trailing slash.
